findings.evidence: Evaluation.lean lines 28-30 of the new file: "and `ev⁻¹(Y)` is one of\nthe space `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` of paths of free loops from a constant loop to a constant loop".
findings.fix: Write "`ev⁻¹(Y)` is a model of (homotopy equivalent to) the space `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` of paths of free loops ...".
findings.issue: Module docstring says "`ev⁻¹(Y)` is one of the space `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q`", which is ungrammatical and leaves unclear how the two spaces are related.

findings.evidence: DoubleLoop.lean:33 "into the space `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` of maps `S² → Q` sending a base point into `Y`"; theorem docstring "`Ω²Sⁿ⁺² → Ω²Q → ev⁻¹(Y) = P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q`"; compare Evaluation.lean:29 "of paths of free loops from a constant loop to a constant loop".
findings.fix: In both places write that `ev⁻¹(Y)` is a model of `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` (via `S²` as the suspension of the circle) instead of equating the two.
findings.issue: The module docstring defines `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` as "the space of maps `S² → Q` sending a base point into `Y`", and the theorem docstring (around line 93) writes `ev⁻¹(Y) = P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q`. Both assert an identity that does not hold; the source's space is paths of free loops (as Evaluation.lean says), and `ev⁻¹(Y)` is only a model of it.

findings.evidence: DoubleLoop.lean:39: "`j_!α₀` of infinite order. In the source this composite is `j_{Y!} α = j^{(Y)}_* j_! β`".
findings.fix: Say that the image of `j_!α₀` under the composite corresponds to the class `j^{(Y)}_* j_! β = j_{Y!} s̃_* β` of the source.
findings.issue: "In the source this composite is `j_{Y!} α = j^{(Y)}_* j_! β`" mixes up a map (the composite) with a homology class.

summary: Docstrings are present and the theorem docstrings match their statements, but the new docs identify the evaluation preimage `ev⁻¹(Y)` with the source's `P_{Q→Y} 𝓛₀Q` inconsistently (garbled in one place, asserted as equality in others) and call a map a homology class.
